{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Strings

|descr= Convert number to NATO phonetical alphabet word (e.g. 2 becomes "Bravo") or letter of alphabet.

|s1= [integer, short] call [[BIS_fnc_phoneticalWord]]

|p1= integer: [[Number]] - any integer from 1 to 26.

|p2= short: [[Boolean]] - (Optional, default [[false]]) [[true]] for the short version, [[false]] for the long version.

|r1= [[String]] - phonetical word or letter of alphabet. In case of full word the returned string [[isLocalized|is localised]].

|x1= <sqf>[1] call BIS_fnc_phoneticalWord; // returns "Alpha"</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>[1, true] call BIS_fnc_phoneticalWord; // returns "A"</sqf>

|seealso= [[BIS_fnc_ordinalNumber]] [[BIS_fnc_romanNumeral]]
}}
